snippet.title: Sword Art Online Fatal Bullet Complete Edition - PC/PS4/XB1 - Opening
snippet.description:
Dive into the adventure of SAO with the Complete Edition of Fatal Bullet out now for PC, PS4 and XB1! 
If you already got the game, don’t miss the new Expansion Pack: Dissonance of the Nexus to continue the adventure with new maps, new friends and new missions.
